annotations.title: Latest published figures for one area

description:
One area's latest PUBLISHED figures from the listing market (asking price and
    £/m², asking rent, gross yield, listings added, reductions, days on market),
    each as {value, unit, period, n, basis}. Each figure is the newest month that
    has ended and has a value, so an empty future month is never shown. Use it to
    answer "what is X like right now". area_type is postcode_district (lowercase, e.g. 'w14'), local_authority (GSS code,
    e.g. 'E09000012'), county or country; area_code is that code. Free text is refused: call
    resolve_place first.

    Pass a full `postcode` instead and it is read at its district. Rungs the
    listing routes serve: postcode districts and local authorities; county and
    country return covered=false with the reason. `beds` narrows to a bedroom
    band; property-type cohorts are not served. `not_published` in the reply names
    what is NOT available today (sold-price medians, turnover, EPC share, owner
    occupancy, HMO share, floor area and year built by district): say so, do not
    guess; use summarise_assets for an on-demand figure.

    Do NOT use it for one property, to value anything, or for a time series
    (area_series). Output is one record under 8 KB. It is free (the same price as
    the listing routes it reads); covered=false or an upstream failure is not
    charged. Free.
name: area_profile
